title: Clearer expandable mobile footer menus
summary: Grouped footer navigation into rounded sections with highlighted open headers and comfortable link rows.

changes.detail: Added outlined accordion sections, green-tinted open headers, stronger labels and 48px link rows with separators and directional arrows.
Replaced the plus/cross toggle with a down/up chevron to clarify expand/collapse behavior while preserving native details keyboard support and all destinations.
